name: EU AI Act: GPAI provider / 通用模型提供者 (draft)
description: Selected Article 53 evidence requests for GPAI model providers, not ordinary downstream API customers. A reviewer must establish scope and transitional dates first.
limitations: Unreviewed subset, not full Article 53, Article 55 systemic-risk compliance, Code of Practice adherence or certification.

Review model-provider status, market placement date, transitional rules and open-source exceptions; scope.eu_gpai_in_scope refers to the selected Article 53 requirements after that review, not just presence of an LLM.

Documentation exceptions differ from copyright and training-summary obligations. Do not set a global false scope solely because a model is open source; review excluded documentation controls separately.

Evidence availability is not legal adequacy. All booleans are supplied claims and documents are not fetched or independently verified. The 30-day freshness interval is local assurance policy, not a legal deadline.

controls.title: Review role, exceptions and transition
controls.remediation: Record applicability and deadlines, plus separate documentation-exemption and systemic-risk decisions.

controls.title: Model documentation record available
controls.remediation: Reference model documentation and downstream information; separately review Annex XI/XII adequacy.

controls.title: Copyright policy record available
controls.remediation: Reference the copyright policy and rights-reservation process.

controls.title: Training-content summary publication recorded
controls.remediation: Retain publication evidence for the training-content summary.

controls.title: Review substantive Article 53 adequacy
controls.remediation: Have qualified reviewers assess documents, copyright measures and the official summary template; do not infer compliance from file presence.
